verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The paper's abbreviations are fixed on the same page: B = 1/2 + σ_j and C_* = B + 1/2 = 1 + σ_j, so M_{C_*−κ_s} is Lean's `MeanClass G.strip (1+σ-κ)` and S_{C_*−κ_s} is `UnweightedClass G.slowStrip (1+σ-κ)`. `waveStage_mean_gain` states four of the five memberships in one conclusion: Δp_m as `next.pressure - u.pressure`, E_θ as `next.thetaResidual c`, E_z as `next.axialResidual c`, and the triple (P, J_θ, J_z) as `DefectBounds G.slowStrip (σ-κ) c next`, which unfolds (CorrectionStep.lean:9711-9712 rewrites `1+(σ-κ) = 1+σ-κ`) to `∀ i : Fin 3, UnweightedClass (1+σ-κ) (debt … i)` with `debt` in the row order (P, J_θ, J_z). The fifth membership, Δg_r, is stated by a separate declaration, `gaugeWaveStage_mean_changes_mem`, at the same exponent α-κ; the α there is instantiated at 1+σ in the cycle, which is exactly the hypothesis `hXC : TensorClass G.strip (1+σ) (covarianceIncrement u.oscillation w)` that `waveStage_mean_gain` itself takes. The two post-stage states agree: `SignedMeanGain.waveStage g c u w q gaussian = reconstructState g c (u.addIncrement zeroTriple 0 w q ⟨0, gaussian, 0⟩)` (SignedMeanGain.lean:168) and `gaugeWaveStage g c u w q e = reconstructState g c (u.addIncrement zeroTriple 0 w q e)` (CorrectionStep.lean:3328) are the same function with e = ⟨0, gaussian, 0⟩. So the recovery is the conjunction of two theorems with a shared hypothesis — packaging, not mathematics.
